quotes.title: Tax refund after implementing the strategies
quotes.quote: $20k tax refund after implementing the tax strategies and advice here. That was not solely because of this course but the course helped a lot. It helped me get off my rear and get more organized.

quotes.title: Credit score, from one utilization change
quotes.quote: Before I got to Module 2, I used to wait for the statement balance and then pay it off in full. But after learning more, I started paying it down before the statement closes to lower my credit utilization - and it boosted my score by 50 points!

quotes.title: Putting the customized blueprint into action
quotes.quote: Went over customized wealth blueprint with Jeff. Much kudos to Jeff! He was very thorough and provided lots of helpful information. Going to view rental properties tomorrow.

quotes.title: Completed all modules - and acted on all of them
quotes.quote: I have set up recurrent automatic investments for DCA, rebalanced my 401K portfolio, frozen my credit with the 3 credit bureaus, and asked about the back door Roth IRA option. My next step is to establish a 2-3 year cash reserve fund.
